name: ItemValueSnapshot
description: A point-in-time valuation snapshot for any collectible item. Supports all modules (pipekeeper, whiskeykeeper, cigarkeeper, winekeeper) and all item types (pipe, tobacco, bottle, cigar, wine).

module_key.description: Module this snapshot belongs to (e.g. pipekeeper, whiskeykeeper)

item_type.description: The type of item this snapshot belongs to within the module (e.g. bottle for whiskeykeeper, pipe or tobacco for pipekeeper)

item_id.description: ID of the item (pipe, tobacco blend, bottle, etc.) this snapshot belongs to

created_by.description: Email of the user who created this snapshot

retail_value.description: Known retail/list price at time of snapshot

market_value.description: Secondary market / aftermarket price at time of snapshot

collector_value.description: Collector-community value estimate at time of snapshot

computed_current_value.description: Engine-computed canonical current value at time of snapshot (preferred field)

computed_value.description: Alias for computed_current_value — kept for backward compatibility

value_confidence.description: Confidence level of the computed value (preferred field)

confidence.description: Alias for value_confidence — kept for backward compatibility

source.description: What data source drove the primary value (e.g. Manual Market Value, Price Per Oz, Collector Value)

rarity_score.description: Engine-computed rarity score 0–100 at time of snapshot

replacement_difficulty.description: Estimated difficulty of replacing this item at time of snapshot

trend_basis.description: Value trend at time of snapshot based on recent snapshot history

recommendation.description: Strategy recommendation at time of snapshot (e.g. use, rotate, preserve, insure for pipes; smoke_now, smoke_later, cellar, hold_for_trade for tobacco; hold, open, either for whiskey)

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about this valuation

is_auto_generated.description: True if this snapshot was created automatically by the system (scheduled refresh or first-view seed), false if created manually by the user
